ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the central and inner regions of both lobes. Dense black pixel mottling and stippling are localized along the trailing edges. A prominent, dark diagonal band is located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an acute angle estimated at 35-40 degrees; depth occupies a significant portion of the fluke's vertical centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge characterized by continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer upper margins, sweeping steeply upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel nodes (barnacles) are clearly visible and concentrated on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark or scratch) is visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally; several finer, faint linear marks are present on the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; prominent dark pigmentation scar or marking on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific geometry of the dark diagonal slash on the right lobe is a highly unique visual marker.
